title: Life Processes: Chapter Introduction
subject: Biology
objective: Even at rest your body keeps working: repair and maintenance need energy all the time. The four life processes: nutrition, respiration, transportation and excretion.

fill.q: The processes that together maintain life are called ____ processes.
Green plants make their own food by ____.
Energy is released from food in the cell organelle called ____.
In humans, blood is pumped by the ____.
Removal of harmful metabolic wastes is called ____.

tf.q: The body needs energy even when we are resting.
tf.explain: Maintenance and repair go on all the time.
Humans depend on food made by others: heterotrophs.
Glucose is broken down, mostly using oxygen.

tf.q: Excretion is the same as egestion.
tf.explain: Excretion removes metabolic wastes; egestion removes undigested food.

ar.a: Even a sleeping person needs energy.
ar.r: Maintenance processes such as repair go on all the time.

ar.a: Blood carries oxygen to every cell.
ar.r: Transportation moves materials to all parts of the body.

short.q: Name the four life processes and state the role of each.
short.solution: Nutrition: taking in food. Respiration: releasing energy from food. Transportation: moving materials to all cells. Excretion: removing harmful wastes.

short.q: Distinguish between autotrophs and heterotrophs with one example each.
short.solution: Autotrophs make their own food (green plants); heterotrophs depend on food made by others (humans).
